core.notes:
New Changelog page (General › Changelog): what changed in AWOO+, newest first
The top bar can have its own scale, separate from the UI scale (Appearance › Layout › Top bar)
A "Tall & very large" Control Panel size
Modules page: the "Shown in" columns are Menu, then Bar, and sit next to the start time
Module settings pages: Defaults and "Reset saved data…" are side by side
Fixed: the wide menu's Profile Sync column lost its fresh/old colours
Diagnostics check-in goes twice a day instead of once
AWOO+ now runs on Queslar 2 only (v2.queslar.com and its test server), no longer on other queslar.com sites
If an old copy of a module is still installed as its own script, the newer copy is the one that runs; debug info marks the old one so you can delete it
The menu's search bar is off by default (turn it on under Appearance › Layout); the arrow keys and Enter still work
The UI scale slider applies when you let go, marks 100%, and has a reset button
Every module's settings page has a Defaults button
Checkbox ticks sit fully inside their box; tools in the menu have a page icon; the update button has a new icon and sits beside the version
The Control Panel sidebar's first group has an "AWOO+" heading
Tools: every input box has the same compact, readable style (Cost Tables' level boxes and the optimizer's ratio boxes were white)
A calmer look in every theme: hover and selection take a faint tint of the theme's colour instead of a grey fill; the top bar is one thin frame with outlines on hover; checkboxes and window headers follow the theme
Profile Sync has its own icon on the top bar: the dot says whether your data is fresh, hovering shows every section and how old it is, clicking opens the details, right-click to sync now, copy or hide it
Fixed: the (i) info icons in the Control Panel were drawn huge
Fixed: Profile Sync's "age unknown" showed as a red box; it is plain text now
UI scale slider (Appearance › Layout): everything AWOO+ draws, from 80% to 130%
Control Panel: a "Tall & large" size, a sidebar width setting, and it now stays above module windows (can be turned off)
Each module's settings page has "Reset saved data…" for when something in it is broken; nothing else is touched
Profile Sync moved under Development; hover a section to see what it holds and which page it was last read on
Slate is the default theme for new installs; a new install starts with every module off and at most five in the menu
Modules: the column is "Loaded" and the buttons say Load / Off; module settings follow your module order; the Tools page has a condensed list
The menu's Modules heading has a faint "manage" link to the Control Panel; the ! mark no longer blinks; smaller close ✕; navigation text is easier to read
The AWOO+ menu is now a searchable list: type to find any module, tool, hidden item or Control Panel page; use the arrow keys and Enter
Each module is one line with its live reading; click to load or unload it (with Undo), or set it to only open its window
Right-click a module in the menu or on the top bar for everything else: open, load, show on the bar or in the menu, settings, bring on-screen
A wide layout adds a second column: details of the selected item, or an overview of Profile Sync and what needs attention (your choice under Appearance › Layout)
"N updates available" appears beside the version and opens the Updates page; the bug button copies debug info to share
Choose how often AWOO+ checks for updates (every 2 hours, once per page load, or only when you ask), and whether it shows a notice
Diagnostics shows what is installed, how much of the browser's storage AWOO+ uses, when the daily check-in last went, and can clear the error list
Profile data now counts as old after 6 hours everywhere, the same as in the tools
Settings is now the AWOO+ Control Panel: General, Appearance and Modules in the sidebar, with each one's pages as tabs; module settings below them, and the Companion under Development
Modules page: load or unload each module, choose whether it shows on the top bar and in the menu, drag to reorder, and set how many top-bar buttons fit (with a live preview on the bar)
Tools and Tweaks get their own pages; hide any tool from the menu. Sculpture Grid Labels is now a tweak
New Profile Sync, Updates and Diagnostics pages: what is synced and who uses it, whether updates are available (and that a check actually ran), and what each module costs and whether anything failed
Choose whether clicking a module in the menu loads it or only opens its window
A module you switch off no longer loads at all: no window, no background work, nothing slowing the page. Switching it back on starts it straight away, with everything it had saved
Switching a module off and on keeps its place on the top bar instead of moving it to the front
If AWOO+ can't save a module's data (for example the browser's storage is full) it now tells you, and keeps retrying, instead of losing it silently

modules.label: Dungeon Win Rate
modules.notes:
Fixed: Clear left the old results on screen and brought them back on the next save; it now clears them completely (and waits while a scan runs)
Runs on Queslar 2 only (v2.queslar.com and its test server)
The top-bar button now reads "Dungeon WR"
Switching it off now fully unloads it; a scan in progress stops, and every page it already read is kept

modules.label: Sculpture Grid Labels
modules.notes:
A rotate button beside the overlay switch swaps the labels between roll % and the sculpture's item level (can be hidden in its settings)
Switching it off now fully unloads it, and it is grouped with the other page tweaks
